researchNotes: Registry-only source for U.S. Virgin Islands DLCA construction contractors and trades license search. DLCA documents board-certification paths for construction contractors, electrical contractors, plumbing contractors, and mechanical/HVAC contractors, while 27 V.I.C. Chapter 10 authorizes specialty-license categories such as roofing, solar construction, swimming pools, remodeling, sewer pipe cleaning, and transmission/distribution lines.
maintainerNotes: Keep DLCA board-certification and business-license paths distinct unless future source research proves a shared data model. Do not treat asbestos as a DLCA contractor/trade license without new official evidence.
